supraorbital_contour.lateral_prominence: The brow ridge extends laterally beyond the outer vertical alignment of the eye corners.

macro_zonal_melanin_distribution.regional_intensity_contrast: Muzzle area exhibits significantly higher pixel intensity (lighter) compared to the low-intensity (darker) cheek and periocular regions.

maxillary_and_labial_geometry.resting_lip_thickness: Thin vertical 2D thickness with minimal structural droop of the lower lip.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A small, distinct, raised protrusion or growth is visible centrally on the forehead, positioned immediately superior to the midpoint of the supraorbital ridge.
other_distinctive_markers: Prominent, high-contrast white/grey-colored hair patch localized to the chin and lower mandible, forming a distinct beard-like feature.
